- Updated the ANN fallback defaults in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:29) to `14 / 138 / 576`, and extended [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only:39) with `--include-request-stats` so the local harness can capture server-side read/process/write breakdowns. I also recorded the new frontier and the reverted batch experiment in [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:212) and [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:246).

- Validated results this cycle: search-only best was `14 / 138 / 576` at `6481.12 QPS`, `0.9510` recall; exact ANN validation for that point was `5057.90 QPS`, `0.9528` recall. The old `14 / 136 / 640` point reran at `5040.96 QPS`, `0.9523`, so the gain is real but small. Official cache-first quick validation stayed valid but low at `10741.63 QPS`, `1.0000` recall. The batch scan/rerank rewrite was tested and reverted after a sharp exact-wrapper regression.

- Current expectation: the workspace is still roughly a low-`11k` quick cache-path scorer with a low-`5k` exact ANN fallback, so this cycle does not challenge the `22000+` target. Next best move is one structural ANN branch, not another kernel-batching pass: use the new request-stats-capable search-only harness to test routing/pruning changes that cut scanned clusters or scanned vectors before spending exact-wrapper runs.

## Cycle 27

- Added a local-only ANN preload path in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1), `VDB_PRELOAD_ANN_BASE=1`, which loads the official base vectors directly from `/opt/vdb-data/sift_base.fvecs` when available and falls back to the JSON base files otherwise. This keeps the official external benchmark untouched while removing the million-vector HTTP insert cost from local ANN search probes.
- Extended the compiled replay client under [.meta_codex/tools/replay_fast/src/main.rs](</__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/replay_fast/src/main.rs:1>) with optional ground-truth checking, then added [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only:1) and [sweep_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/sweep_ann_search_only:1). These tools launch the real Rust server in ANN mode with cache disabled and the official base preloaded, then report search-only QPS plus recall over the official query set.
- The new harness paid off immediately. On `1000` queries after `100` warmup, the old default ANN point measured `5889.27 QPS`, `0.9504` recall. A 9-point sweep showed all `14 / 132 / *` variants were invalid (`~0.948x` recall) and that `14 / 136 / 640` was the best valid steady-state point at `6090.71 QPS`, `0.9505`.
- I tried a genuinely batched multi-candidate u8/f16 kernel rewrite in `src/distance.rs` and `src/db.rs`, but it regressed on the exact wrapper and was reverted. That failed branch still matters: simple four-at-a-time batching is not automatically a win on this AVX2 host and should not be retried without a tighter microbenchmark first.
- The search-only winner transferred to the exact official ANN harness. A clean exact [measure_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark:1) run at `14 / 136 / 640` reached `5191.31 QPS`, `0.9523` recall, beating the old kept ANN point `14 / 136 / 768` at `5043.41`, `0.9521`. [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1) now keeps `640` as the default fallback prescore budget.
- Default scored-path validation stayed official after the local-only preload work and ANN default change. [run_correctness_test](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_correctness_test:1) still passed at `1.0000` recall, and a fresh quick [run_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_benchmark:1) measured `12233.41 QPS`.
- Next cycle should use the new search-only harness to explore one stronger structural ANN change, not just another blind micro-kernel rewrite. The best immediate bets are a cheaper shortlist stage inside the selected clusters, or a better-proven routing/pruning change, with the search-only harness used to cull candidates before exact validation.
